Employment Practices Liability 
 
Table EPL.1 is deleted and replaced by the following: 
 
 
Table EPL.20 is introduced below.  This table contains additional factors used only for California accounts, depending on the 
insured location within the state of California.   This table is used in an additional step which falls between steps (e) and (f) of 
the rating algorithm.  Multiply the result of step (e) by this factor, before proceeding to step (f).
